## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the observed failure and the behavior this change produces.

## Validation

State which checks ran and what remains unverified. For a diagnostic, include a
synthetic failing case, repaired case and negative control, plus primary sources.

- [ ] No real HAR, signed URL, token, customer data or private endpoint included.
- [ ] Unknown and unsupported outcomes remain explicit.
- [ ] Public interface and documentation changes are documented.
- [ ] Applicable offline, browser and package checks ran.

For a vulnerability, use SECURITY.md rather than a public pull request.
